items: Data is now backed up automatically every 6 hours.
Comments can now include an attached image — click it to view full-size.
Fixed a bug where undoing a deleted comment could let someone else's name be forged on it.
Added this "what's new" panel — click the megaphone icon in the top bar any time.
The login screen now shows the app version.
QA-flagged issues can now be marked ignored or approved so they stop cluttering the queue.
Undo now works for deleted suggestions, not just deleted comments.
Avatar upload now accepts real image files up to 2MB (was a smaller base64 upload before), and you can remove your avatar.
Notifications now only fire for @mentions and direct replies, cutting down on noise.
Fixed low-contrast text on hover for buttons.
Non-admins can now request a brand-new project instead of only joining existing ones.
Added user reporting, so members can flag a problem with another user to a project admin.
Added a live presence view of who's online and what they're editing.
Approvals can now be applied in bulk instead of one at a time.
Added suggestions: once a string is translated, others propose changes instead of overwriting it directly.
Added comment reactions and threaded replies.
You can now change your own password and log yourself out of other sessions.
Links to a specific project/tab now survive a page refresh.
The app now supports multiple translation projects, each with its own files, comments, and roles.
Added project creation, switching, and a request-to-join flow.
Added a notification feed for activity on your files.
